data.desc: SBC Medical is a Medical Services Organization providing management support across a wide range of healthcare fields, including advanced aesthetic healthcare, dermatology, orthopedics, fertility treatment, gynecology, dentistry, hair loss treatment (AGA), and ophthalmology. The Company manages a diverse portfolio of clinic brands and is expanding its global presence, particularly in the United States and Asia, through operations and medical tourism initiatives. The Company was listed on Nasdaq in September 2024 and was selected for inclusion in the Russell 3000 Index in June 2025.
